Unknown with a type.description: Declare an unknown with an explicit type

Unknown integer in a range.description: Declare an unknown integer with an inclusive domain

Constraint.description: State a constraint every solution must satisfy

All different.description: Require pairwise distinct values (arrives with arrays in Phase 3)

Solve with body.description: Find one solution and print it

Solve all.description: Enumerate solutions (projected on the listed variables), up to a limit

Solve unique.description: Find a solution and prove that no other exists

Solve minimize.description: Find a solution minimizing an objective

Solve maximize.description: Find a solution maximizing an objective

For loop.description: Compile-time loop over a half-open range (unrolled)

If / else.description: Conditional block with an else branch

Function.description: Function definition (inlined at every call) (arrives in Phase 3)
